title: Kucong language
description: Loloish language of China and Vietnam
extract: Kucong, or Lahlu, is a Loloish language of Yunnan, China and Vietnam, primarily spoken by the Kucong people. In Vietnam, the speakers' autonym is, and they are also known as the La Hủ Na 'Black Lahu'. The language is very closely related to Lahu.
